definition: to change words into a different language
example: I used a smartphone app to translate the Korean sentence into English.
translation: 나는 그 한국어 문장을 영어로 번역하기 위해 스마트폰 앱을 사용했다.

definition: a planned series of actions for achieving something
example: We need a good strategy to win the soccer game tomorrow.
translation: 내일 축구 경기에서 이기기 위해 우리는 좋은 전략이 필요하다.

definition: relating to work that needs special skills or training
example: If you want to be a professional gamer, you have to practice every day.
translation: 전문적인 게이머가 되고 싶다면 너는 매일 연습해야 한다.

definition: the completion of a school or university course
example: We are going to take a lot of pictures after the middle school graduation.
translation: 우리는 중학교 졸업식 후에 사진을 많이 찍을 것이다.

definition: the main idea or theme of something
example: The video was popular because of its interesting concept.
translation: 그 영상은 흥미로운 콘셉트 때문에 인기를 끌었다.

definition: clothes worn by actors or clothes worn to look like someone else
example: She made her own costume for the school play.
translation: 그녀는 학교 연극을 위해 자신의 의상을 직접 만들었다.

definition: to put clothes on yourself or someone else
example: He dressed up nicely for his sister's wedding.
translation: 그는 누나의 결혼식을 위해 멋지게 옷을 차려입었다.

definition: to draw or plan something before making it
example: The students designed a poster to protect the environment.
translation: 학생들은 환경을 보호하기 위해 포스터를 디자인했다.

definition: a person whose job is designing buildings
example: My dream is to become a great architect who builds eco-friendly houses.
translation: 내 꿈은 친환경적인 집을 짓는 훌륭한 건축가가 되는 것이다.

definition: having a smooth, round shape; not straight
example: The new smartphone has a beautiful curved screen.
translation: 그 새 스마트폰은 아름다운 곡선 화면을 가지고 있다.

definition: full of energy and new ideas
example: K-pop dances are very dynamic and fun to watch.
translation: K팝 댄스는 매우 역동적이고 보기에 재미있다.

definition: an area of land that is partly covered with water
example: The wetland is an important place because many rare birds live there.
translation: 그 습지는 많은 희귀한 새들이 살고 있기 때문에 중요한 장소이다.

definition: to make someone want to do something creative
example: Reading many books will inspire you to write a good story.
translation: 많은 책을 읽는 것은 네가 좋은 이야기를 쓰도록 영감을 줄 것이다.

definition: existing in nature and not made by people
example: Jeju Island is famous for its beautiful natural landscapes.
translation: 제주도는 아름다운 자연 풍경으로 유명하다.

definition: a large area of natural land that you can see
example: I like painting the beautiful landscape of my hometown.
translation: 나는 내 고향의 아름다운 풍경을 그리는 것을 좋아한다.

definition: the art and study of designing and building structures
example: I want to go to university to study modern architecture.
translation: 나는 현대 건축학을 공부하기 위해 대학교에 가고 싶다.

definition: having four equal sides and four right angles
example: The teacher asked us to draw a square box on the paper.
translation: 선생님은 우리에게 종이 위에 사각형 상자를 그리라고 하셨다.

definition: having a particular shape
example: He gave me a special cookie shaped like a star.
translation: 그는 나에게 별 모양의 특별한 쿠키를 주었다.

definition: to greet someone in a polite and friendly way
example: The principal warmly welcomed the new students at the entrance.
translation: 교장 선생님은 입구에서 신입생들을 따뜻하게 환영했다.

definition: a person who uses the services or advice of a professional person
example: The designer is listening to her client to understand what he wants.
translation: 그 디자이너는 그 고객이 무엇을 원하는지 이해하기 위해 고객의 말을 듣고 있다.

definition: to agree with and help someone or something
example: My parents always support me when I have a difficult problem.
translation: 내가 어려운 문제를 겪을 때 부모님은 항상 나를 지지해 주신다.

definition: the achievement of an aim or purpose
example: Hard work and practice are the keys to success.
translation: 노력과 연습이 성공의 열쇠이다.

definition: to look like or be like someone or something
example: People say that I resemble my older brother, but our personalities are different.
translation: 사람들은 내가 형을 닮았다고 하지만, 우리의 성격은 다르다.

definition: a small, smooth, round stone, especially one found on a beach or in a river
example: The children were throwing small pebbles into the lake.
translation: 아이들이 호수 안으로 작은 조약돌들을 던지고 있었다.

definition: the land along the edge of the sea
example: We collected beautiful shells while walking along the seashore.
translation: 우리는 해안을 따라 걷는 동안 아름다운 조개껍데기를 모았다.

definition: moving; not completely still
example: It is dangerous to jump out of a bus while it is in motion.
translation: 버스가 움직이고 있는 동안 버스 밖으로 뛰어내리는 것은 위험하다.

definition: a prize given to someone for something that person has achieved
example: Jimin won the first prize award in the English speaking contest.
translation: 지민이는 영어 말하기 대회에서 1등 상을 받았다.

definition: to die (a polite way of saying die)
example: I felt very sad when my favorite singer passed away last month.
translation: 지난달에 내가 가장 좋아하는 가수가 사망했을 때 나는 매우 슬펐다.

definition: to succeed at finishing something or reaching an aim
example: If you don't give up, you will finally achieve your goals.
translation: 만약 네가 포기하지 않는다면, 마침내 너의 목표를 달성할 것이다.

definition: to take place, usually without being planned
example: I wonder what will happen in the next episode of this drama.
translation: 이 드라마의 다음 에피소드에서 무슨 일이 일어날지 궁금하다.
